notes: Grundl Cargo Deck, 4x4: a top-down freight hold: hazard-striped lane edges, a stack of crates (brown wood and steel containers with amber stripes), a rack of big shells at the right, a loading hoist whose chain and hook swing on the 4-frame loop, a blinking amber lamp. Off: dim, the hook at rest. Damaged: a crate toppled and split, the chain bent, a lamp dead. Disabled: crates spilled and dark, the hoist hanging snapped.
